name: bar_frame
prompt:
Redraw the reference picture, a wide horizontal loading-bar frame on a transparent background, keeping EXACTLY the same outline shape, size and position and the same long rounded window in the middle (the window's inside stays solid black), but restyle it for a snowy ski resort: the frame made of icy sky-blue and white with thick snow piled along its top edge and little icicles, the gas nozzle on the left replaced by a cartoon green cannabis leaf wearing a tiny beanie, the letters E and F replaced by a tiny snowflake on the left and a tiny mountain peak on the right. Nothing else.

Style: flat 2D adult-animation TV cartoon (late-night animated sitcom look). Thick, even, confident black outlines; flat cel colours with at most one simple hard-edged shadow tone and one small white highlight; bright saturated candy colours; chunky, rounded, slightly goofy proportions; simple readable shapes. NO realistic lighting, NO gradients, NO painterly texture, NO 3D render, NO photo. Clean vector-like finish.
